disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读服务端全部源码，检查硬编码密钥、口令、令牌以及常见凭据文件位置（如 .credentials.yaml、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据文件）的读取；未发现此类读取。
checked_items.en: After reading through all server-side source code, checked for reads of hardcoded keys, passwords, tokens, and common credential file locations (e.g., .credentials.yaml, SSH private keys, cloud vendor credential files); no such reads were found.

checked_items.zh: 日志模块对常见密钥形态（sk-、ghp_、npm_、Bearer 等）做了打码处理，不落盘、不发送。
checked_items.en: The logging module masks common credential patterns (sk-, ghp_, npm_, Bearer, etc.), which are not persisted to disk and not sent out.

checked_items.zh: Gist 令牌只保存在会话内存或从环境变量读取，不写入磁盘；GitHub CLI 令牌缓存仅存于进程内存，10 分钟过期。
checked_items.en: Gist tokens are only kept in session memory or read from environment variables, never written to disk; the GitHub CLI token cache is only kept in process memory and expires after 10 minutes.

checked_items.zh: 备份功能会导出 profile 配置文件（含可能包含密钥的 config.toml、.env 等），UI 在导出前明确警告；该功能由用户主动发起，且导入侧有公共互联网地址校验（WebDAV）或严格白名单（Gist ID）。
checked_items.en: The backup feature exports profile config files (including config.toml, .env, etc., which may contain secrets); the UI warns explicitly before export; this feature is user-initiated, and the import side has public internet address validation (WebDAV) or a strict whitelist (Gist ID).

checked_items.zh: 客户端 bundle 中未发现任何凭据 RPC 调用（如 credentials.set 等）。
checked_items.en: No credential RPC calls (e.g., credentials.set) were found in the client bundle.

checked_items.zh: static-scan 规则（DG-R1-51/52/53 对应 DSH-C01/C02/C04）全部核查：未命中任何敏感路径读取或凭据访问代码路径。
checked_items.en: All static-scan rules (DG-R1-51/52/53 corresponding to DSH-C01/C02/C04) were checked: no sensitive path reads or credential access code paths were hit.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取 DSH 凭据文件或 SSH 私钥等敏感路径的代码；备份功能读取 profile 配置文件属于用户主动发起的备份行为，界面已对可能含密钥的文件给出警告。D4 侧外联通道均为固定合法端点，无「凭据读取+外发」的组合链路。
evidence.en: No code reading sensitive paths such as DSH credential files or SSH private keys was found; the backup feature's reading of profile config files is a user-initiated backup action, and the UI warns about files that may contain secrets. All outbound channels on the D4 side point to fixed legitimate endpoints, with no combined 'credential read + exfiltration' chain.

checked_items.zh: 全树搜索各类 agent 指令文件（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursor、.claude、mcp.json、SKILL.md 等），不存在。
checked_items.en: Searched the full tree for various agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor, .claude, mcp.json, SKILL.md, etc.); none exist.

checked_items.zh: 本插件未向模型注册任何工具（无 ctx.tools.register 调用），也没有注入系统提示的调用（无 ctx.systemPrompt.section 调用）。
checked_items.en: This plugin does not register any tools with the model (no ctx.tools.register calls) and has no calls for injecting system prompts (no ctx.systemPrompt.section calls).

checked_items.zh: 未发现注册 LLM 适配器（registerAdapter）、监听 agent/request 路由事件、监听 agent/pre-step 消息改写事件、监听 agent/request-error 错误恢复接管事件（DSH-L01~L03/L06 规则全部核查）。
checked_items.en: No LLM adapter registration (registerAdapter), no listening to agent/request route events, no listening to agent/pre-step message rewrite events, no listening to agent/request-error error recovery takeover events (all DSH-L01~L03/L06 rules checked).

checked_items.zh: 未发现提供 CompactionEngine 压缩引擎或 AttachmentStore 附件存储实现（DSH-L08/L09 规则核查）。
checked_items.en: No CompactionEngine implementation or AttachmentStore implementation found (DSH-L08/L09 rules checked).

checked_items.zh: 通读 README、说明文档、界面文案与代码注释，未发现要求模型忽略规则、伪装系统消息、拉取远程指令等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through README, documentation, UI copy, and code comments; no wording requiring the model to ignore rules, disguise system messages, fetch remote instructions, or similar injection language was found.

checked_items.zh: 「AI 修复」功能把诊断摘要复制到剪贴板，由用户自行粘贴到新会话并决定是否发送；提示内容为保守修复要求，不自动执行。
checked_items.en: The 'AI fix' feature copies diagnostic summaries to the clipboard for the user to manually paste into a new session and decide whether to send; the prompt content is conservative fix requirements and is not auto-executed.

checked_items.zh: static-scan 规则（DG-R2-57 对应 DSH-X10 模型面指令文件）核查：树内无 SKILL.md 或 AGENTS.md。
checked_items.en: static-scan rule (DG-R2-57 corresponding to DSH-X10 model-facing instruction files) checked: no SKILL.md or AGENTS.md in the tree.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何面向模型的工具描述，不存在工具描述投毒的攻击面。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions are registered for the model; no tool description poisoning attack surface exists.

evidence.zh: 界面安装/更新操作均需用户点击确认，且只接受精选目录中的来源；未发现诱导自动安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: UI install/update operations all require user click confirmation and only accept sources from the curated directory; no wording inducing auto-install, rewriting configs, or opening permissions was found.

evidence.zh: 未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在 pre-step 消息改写攻击面。
evidence.en: No listening to agent/pre-step events; no pre-step message rewrite attack surface exists.

checked_items.zh: 服务端与浏览器端 bundle 全树未发现动态执行写法（eval、new Function、解码后执行等）。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution patterns (eval, new Function, decode-then-execute, etc.) were found in the full trees of the server and browser bundles.

checked_items.zh: 自带的挂载补丁（cordis.patch.yml）只有一行插入声明，不含任何可执行标量（无 !!js 表达式）。
checked_items.en: The bundled patch (cordis.patch.yml) is only a single-line insertion declaration with no executable scalars (no !!js expressions).

checked_items.zh: 安装/卸载/更新通过子进程调用 dsh 命令，属于本插件声明的核心功能；传给命令的安装目标只来自精选注册表（awesome-dsh-plugin.com），经严格的 URL 与来源校验，不允许自由输入。
checked_items.en: Install/uninstall/update invoke dsh commands via subprocess, which is a declared core feature of this plugin; install targets passed to the command only come from the curated registry (awesome-dsh-plugin.com), validated strictly by URL and source, with no free-form input allowed.

checked_items.zh: 客户端 bundle 的键盘监听仅用于 UI 交互（Esc 关闭弹窗、翻页键图片预览），未发现按键记录或窃取行为。
checked_items.en: The keyboard listener in the client bundle is only for UI interactions (Esc closes modals, page/arrow keys for image preview); no keylogging or theft behavior was found.

checked_items.zh: 客户端 bundle 的剪贴板写入仅出现在用户点击复制安装命令或诊断提示时，未发现自动读取剪贴板内容。
checked_items.en: Clipboard writes in the client bundle only occur when the user clicks copy for install commands or diagnostic prompts; no automatic clipboard reading was found.

checked_items.zh: vm.Script 仅用于编译检查已安装插件的客户端 bundle 语法（不执行代码），属安全语法验证。
checked_items.en: vm.Script is only used for compile-checking the syntax of installed plugins' client bundles (without executing code), which is a safe syntax validation.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对宿主动态执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的任何调用。
checked_items.en: No calls to host dynamic execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run classes) were found.

checked_items.zh: 未发现注册外部子代理提供方（registerProvider 调用，DSH-L04 规则核查）。
checked_items.en: No external sub-agent provider registration (registerProvider calls, DSH-L04 rule checked).

checked_items.zh: 未发现 dsh 原生持驻注册（jobs.start、schedule_create、create_goal 等，DSH-L05 规则核查）。
checked_items.en: No native dsh residency registration (jobs.start, schedule_create, create_goal, etc., DSH-L05 rule checked).

checked_items.zh: 未发现监听 agent/turn-stopping 轮次续命事件（DSH-L07 规则核查）。
checked_items.en: No listening to agent/turn-stopping round-lengthening events (DSH-L07 rule checked).

checked_items.zh: 树内未发现 husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile 等执行载体；package.json 的 prepare 钩子仅为自身 TypeScript 构建，属于正常构建步骤。
checked_items.en: No execution carriers such as husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile were found in the tree; the prepare hook in package.json is only for building its own TypeScript, a normal build step.

checked_items.zh: static-scan 中 DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 命中 .github/workflows 三个文件：属 CI 自动化面，不随插件在用户机器运行。
checked_items.en: In static-scan, DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 hit three files under .github/workflows: they belong to the CI automation surface and do not run on the user's machine as part of the plugin.

checked_items.zh: static-scan 中 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 命中两条超长行（客户端 bundle 中的 CSS 与 source map），属构建产物，非混淆代码。
checked_items.en: In static-scan, DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 hit two overly long lines (CSS and source map in the client bundle), which are build artifacts, not obfuscated code.

evidence.zh: 自带补丁文件为纯插入声明，未发现 !!js 等可执行标量；代码中对 !!js 的引用只出现在注释、文档与测试样例中，解析时也不执行。
evidence.en: The bundled patch file is a pure insertion declaration; no executable scalars like !!js were found; references to !!js in the code appear only in comments, documentation, and test examples, and are not executed during parsing.

evidence.zh: 未发现对宿主动态执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的任何调用。
evidence.en: No calls to host dynamic execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run classes) were found.

evidence.zh: 安装钩子仅有构建自身的 prepare 步骤；GitHub Actions 工作流属 CI 自动化面，不随插件在用户机器运行。
evidence.en: The only install hook is the prepare step for building itself; GitHub Actions workflows belong to the CI automation surface and do not run on the user's machine as part of the plugin.

evidence.zh: 客户端 bundle 的键盘监听仅为关闭弹层与图片预览翻页等 UI 用途，剪贴板写入仅为用户点击复制安装命令或诊断提示；未发现按键记录、剪贴板窃取或凭据 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: The keyboard listener in the client bundle is only for closing modals and image preview paging, and clipboard writes are only for user-clicked copies of install commands or diagnostic prompts; no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC calls were found.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何子代理提供方，不存在外部子代理委派攻击面。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider registration; no external sub-agent delegation attack surface exists.

evidence.zh: 未使用 dsh 原生持驻机制（jobs.start、schedule_create、goals 等），不存在 dsh 原生持驻攻击面。
evidence.en: No native dsh residency mechanisms (jobs.start, schedule_create, goals, etc.) are used; no dsh native residency attack surface exists.

checked_items.zh: 梳理全部出站请求：目录清单（awesome-dsh-plugin.com）、npm 版本检查（registry.npmjs.org）、GitHub 更新检查与 Gist 备份（api.github.com）、浏览器端从 GitHub 官方域名加载插件 README/截图。
checked_items.en: All outbound requests reviewed: directory listings (awesome-dsh-plugin.com), npm version checks (registry.npmjs.org), GitHub update checks and Gist backups (api.github.com), browser-side loading of plugin README/screenshots from GitHub official domains.

checked_items.zh: 中国区下载模式使用 gh-proxy.com（GitHub 代理）与 mirrors.cloud.tencent.com（npm 镜像），均为用户可切换的公开服务，不携带敏感数据。
checked_items.en: China-region download mode uses gh-proxy.com (GitHub proxy) and mirrors.cloud.tencent.com (npm mirror), both user-switchable public services, carrying no sensitive data.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码后外发、DNS 隧道、webhook 回传等隐蔽通道；日志导出为本地文本且已打码。
checked_items.en: No covert channels such as encoded exfiltration, DNS tunneling, or webhook callback were found; log export is a local text file with masking already applied.

checked_items.zh: 未发现监听 agent/request 路由事件（DSH-L01）或注册自定义 LLM 适配器（DSH-L02），不存在路由劫持外发面。
checked_items.en: No listening to agent/request route events (DSH-L01) or custom LLM adapter registration (DSH-L02); no route hijacking exfiltration surface exists.

checked_items.zh: 未发现监听 agent/request-error 错误恢复事件（DSH-L06），不存在错误恢复劫持外发面。
checked_items.en: No listening to agent/request-error error recovery events (DSH-L06); no error recovery hijacking exfiltration surface exists.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端头像缩略图经 images.weserv.nl 第三方图片缩放服务加载，仅传递公开的 GitHub 头像地址，无敏感数据。
checked_items.en: The browser-side avatar thumbnail is loaded via the third-party image scaling service images.weserv.nl, which only receives public GitHub avatar URLs with no sensitive data.

checked_items.zh: static-scan 中 DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 命中 curl 均出现在 CI 工作流与 package.json 快照脚本中，属开发者/CI 主动触发，非插件运行时外发。
checked_items.en: In static-scan, DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 hits for curl all appear in CI workflows and package.json snapshot scripts, which are developer/CI-triggered, not plugin-runtime outbound.

evidence.zh: 服务端无凭据文件读取，也没有「凭据读取 + 外发」的组合链路；备份上传（WebDAV/Gist）均由用户主动发起，且 WebDAV 目标需通过公网地址校验、Gist 目标固定为 GitHub 官方 API。
evidence.en: The server has no credential file reads and no combined 'credential read + exfiltration' chain; backup uploads (WebDAV/Gist) are all user-initiated, with WebDAV targets validated against public internet addresses and Gist targets fixed to the official GitHub API.

evidence.zh: 未监听 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件，未注册 LLM 自定义适配器，不存在 LLM 路由运行时劫持攻击面。
evidence.en: No listening to agent/request or agent/request-error events, no custom LLM adapter registration; no LLM routing runtime hijacking attack surface exists.

checked_items.zh: 安装入口只接受精选注册表（awesome-dsh-plugin.com）中的来源，npm 包名与 GitHub 仓库路径均经格式校验，排除外部输入。
checked_items.en: The install entry only accepts sources from the curated registry (awesome-dsh-plugin.com); npm package names and GitHub repository paths are format-validated, excluding external input.

checked_items.zh: 自带依赖仅 js-yaml 与 undici（网络请求库），peer 依赖为官方 @deepseek-ai/cordis、@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings 等，未发现仿冒包名或未锁定版本的 git 引用。
checked_items.en: Bundled dependencies are only js-yaml and undici (an HTTP client library), with peer dependencies being official @deepseek-ai/cordis, @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings, etc.; no counterfeit package names or unpinned git references were found.

checked_items.zh: 写用户补丁层时保护宿主基础设施模块（@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-*、@deepseek-ai/dsh-* 等数十个核心模块），拒绝在格式非法的补丁文件上追加。
checked_items.en: When writing the user patch layer, host infrastructure modules (@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-*, @deepseek-ai/dsh-*, among dozens of core modules) are protected, and appending to malformed patch files is refused.

checked_items.zh: 未监听安全事件（tools/pre-execute、approval/request）或截断审批链。
checked_items.en: No listening to security events (tools/pre-execute, approval/request) or truncating the approval chain.

checked_items.zh: 生成的补丁条目仅涉及插件启用/停用，不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行。
checked_items.en: Generated patch entries only involve plugin enable/disable and do not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions.

checked_items.zh: static-scan 中 DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 命中 data/registry-snapshot.json 中 50 余个 install 字段，均为第三方插件目录数据，非本插件安装钩子。
checked_items.en: In static-scan, DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 hit over 50 install fields in data/registry-snapshot.json, all third-party plugin directory data, not this plugin's install hooks.

checked_items.zh: static-scan 中 DSH-S04/DG-R5-56（floating 引用）核查：无未锁定版本的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: In static-scan, DSH-S04/DG-R5-56 (floating references) checked: no unpinned git dependencies found.

evidence.zh: 本插件不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行；写入用户补丁层的仅是对插件条目的启用/停用，且拒绝追加到非法格式的文件。
evidence.en: This plugin does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; the only writes to the user patch layer are enabling/disabling plugin entries, and appending to files in invalid formats is refused.

evidence.zh: 未发现对工具预执行、审批请求等 waterfall 安全事件的高优先级监听或截断。
evidence.en: No high-priority listening or truncation of waterfall security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests was found.

evidence.zh: 本次审计为 release-full 模式，已与上一版本报告（1.18.0）比对；manifest 声明（dsh.bundle/dsh.client）与前一版本一致，未见能力声明突变。
evidence.en: This audit is in release-full mode and was compared with the previous version's report (1.18.0); manifest declarations (dsh.bundle/dsh.client) are consistent with the previous version, with no capability declaration changes.

evidence.zh: 未改写其他插件的注入/拦截配置，自带补丁亦无此类字段。
evidence.en: No rewriting of other plugins' injection/interception configurations; the bundled patch also has no such fields.

checked_items.zh: 本插件不自行监听端口，路由挂载在宿主 Web 服务上；所有变更类接口要求同源请求（sameOrigin 检查），进程控制类接口（重启、自卸载、备份导出）额外要求回环来源且拒绝转发头。
checked_items.en: This plugin does not listen on ports itself; routes are mounted on the host Web service. All mutation-type interfaces require same-origin requests (sameOrigin check), and process-control interfaces (restart, self-uninstall, backup export) additionally require loopback origin and reject forwarded headers.

checked_items.zh: 备份恢复功能会按备份内容执行 pnpm install，用户导入不可信备份文件可导致安装其中列出的插件——属该功能的固有语义（等同用户主动安装不可信插件），非快照自身漏洞，已留痕观察。
checked_items.en: The backup restore feature runs pnpm install according to the backup contents; a user importing an untrusted backup file could install plugins listed in it — this is inherent to the feature's semantics (equivalent to the user actively installing untrusted plugins), not a snapshot vulnerability, and is noted for observation.

checked_items.zh: WebDAV 上传目标经严格 SSRF 防护（https-only、公网 IP 校验、DNS 重绑定防护、来源绑定校验）。
checked_items.en: WebDAV upload targets are strictly protected against SSRF (https-only, public IP validation, DNS rebinding protection, source binding validation).

checked_items.zh: Gist 备份操作仅限 api.github.com，Gist ID 经严格字符白名单校验。
checked_items.en: Gist backup operations are restricted to api.github.com, and Gist IDs undergo strict character whitelist validation.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（本次运行无动态观测产物），运行时行为结论以静态分析为准。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not executed (no dynamic observation artifacts in this run); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis only.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动自己的 Web 服务；对宿主 Web 服务上挂载的接口施加了同源与回环限制。宿主本身无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own Web service; interfaces mounted on the host Web service are subject to same-origin and loopback restrictions. The host's unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 清单校验通过：dsh 插件声明有效（dsh.bundle + dsh.client），补丁为纯插入声明，来源仓库与作者标识一致。
summary.en: Manifest validation passed: the dsh plugin declaration is valid (dsh.bundle + dsh.client), the patch is a pure insertion declaration, and the source repository matches the author identifier.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：全部机械命中逐条裁决为良性或不在插件运行面，未形成发现。
summary.en: Static scan complete: all mechanical hits were individually adjudicated as benign or outside the plugin's runtime surface, resulting in no findings.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：安装钩子仅为构建自身，无编码载荷、无凭据读取、无隐蔽外联。
summary.en: Behavior analysis complete: the only install hook is for building itself; no encoded payloads, credential reads, or covert outbound connections.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：无工具描述投毒（未注册工具）、无指令注入措辞，文档与界面文案干净。
summary.en: AI metadata review complete: no tool description poisoning (no tools registered), no instruction injection wording, and documentation and UI copy are clean.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（运行环境未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: This stage did not perform dynamic sandbox verification (the runtime environment did not provide dynamic observation artifacts).

limits.zh:
动态沙箱未执行：本次运行没有动态观测产物，DG-L4 判为不适用，运行时行为结论全部来自静态分析。

static-scan 命中 51 条逐条裁决（全部排除，无 finding）：DSH-X07/DG-R3-59（.github/workflows 三个工作流文件，属 CI 自动化面，不纳入插件运行时审计）；DSH-C05/DG-R4-53（工作流与 package.json 快照脚本中的 curl，均为开发者/CI 主动触发的目录抓取，非插件运行时外发）；DSH-X05/DG-R3-57（键盘监听为 Esc/翻页等 UI 交互，剪贴板写入为用户点击复制，源码与打包产物一致）；DSH-X08/DG-R3-60（打包产物中的超长 CSS 行与 source map，属构建产物非混淆代码；日志模块的控制字符过滤正则属正常安全过滤）；DSH-X01/DG-R3-53（data/registry-snapshot.json 中 cordis_define 出现在第三方插件描述文本中，非本插件代码）；DSH-X02/DG-R3-54（同文件中 50 余处 install 字段为第三方插件目录数据，非本插件安装钩子；本插件 package.json 的 prepare 钩子为构建自身，良性）；DSH-X03/DG-R3-55（子进程调用集中在安装/重启/Gist 令牌读取等核心功能，目标经注册表白名单校验或为固定命令，无任意命令执行风险）；DSH-P01/DG-R3-51（!!js 仅出现在注释、文档与测试样例中，树内补丁无该标量）。

备份/恢复设计观察：恢复功能会按备份内容重装依赖，用户导入不可信备份文件可导致安装其中列出的插件——属该功能的固有语义（等同用户主动安装不可信插件），非快照自身漏洞，未立案。

客户端头像与截图缩略图经 images.weserv.nl 第三方图片缩放服务加载，仅传递公开的 GitHub 图片地址，无敏感数据——README 中「图片仅从 GitHub 加载」的表述与之略有出入，已留痕观察，不定为发现。

两个超读帽文件：data/registry-snapshot.json（约 144K tokens）与 client/client.js（约 111K tokens）——对 registry-snapshot.json 通过 grep 精确定位了 DSH-X01/DSH-X02 命中点并抽样验证了数据格式；对 client/client.js 已通过 grep 确认所有 DSH-X05 命中点（键盘监听、剪贴板）与源码一致，无需全文通读。
limits.en:
Dynamic sandbox not executed: this run produced no dynamic observation artifacts, so DG-L4 is deemed not applicable, and all runtime behavior conclusions come from static analysis.

All 51 static-scan hits were adjudicated individually (all excluded, no findings): DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 (three .github/workflows workflow files, CI automation surface, not included in plugin runtime audit); DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 (curl in workflows and package.json snapshot scripts, developer/CI-triggered directory fetches, not plugin runtime outbound); DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 (keyboard listener for Esc/paging UI interactions, clipboard writes on user-click copy, source and bundled artifacts consistent); DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 (overly long CSS lines and source map in build artifacts, not obfuscated code; the logging module's control-character filter regex is normal security filtering); DSH-X01/DG-R3-53 (cordis_define in data/registry-snapshot.json appears in third-party plugin description text, not this plugin's code); DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 (over 50 install fields in the same file are third-party plugin directory data, not this plugin's install hooks; this plugin's package.json prepare hook is for building itself, benign); DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 (subprocess calls are concentrated in core functions such as install/restart/Gist token reading, targets are whitelisted by the registry or fixed commands, no arbitrary command execution risk); DSH-P01/DG-R3-51 (!!js appears only in comments, documentation, and test examples; the in-tree patch has no such scalar).

Backup/restore design observation: the restore feature re-installs dependencies according to backup contents; a user importing an untrusted backup file could install plugins listed in it — inherent to the feature's semantics (equivalent to the user actively installing untrusted plugins), not a snapshot vulnerability, not filed.

Client avatar and screenshot thumbnails are loaded via the third-party image scaling service images.weserv.nl, which only receives public GitHub image URLs, with no sensitive data — the README's statement 'images are loaded only from GitHub' is slightly inconsistent with this, noted for observation, not determined as a finding.

Two over-read-limit files: data/registry-snapshot.json (~144K tokens) and client/client.js (~111K tokens) — for registry-snapshot.json, grep precisely located DSH-X01/DSH-X02 hits and sampled the data format; for client/client.js, grep confirmed all DSH-X05 hits (keyboard listener, clipboard) are consistent with the source, so a full read was not necessary.
